title: 7.13 Sofia is good at tennis
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Say what people are good at with be + good at (Sofia is good at tennis. / Luis isn't good at tennis.), ask What are you good at?, and name two more: basketball and playing the piano.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.13 Sports and Music: A1 names sports and singing (Tennis is a sport. They sing.); A1+ 7.13 says who is good at them. The one new grammar relationship is be + good at + a sport or an -ing activity (Sofia is good at tennis. / They're good at singing.), with isn't/aren't for the opposite (A1+ 3.4) and the question What are you good at?. Two new photos show Sofia playing tennis well and Luis sitting on the court among missed balls; A1 7.13's singers and the cast's A1+ photos of painting, swimming and running come back. Two words are new and stay inside the same frame: basketball, a sport like tennis (Luis is good at basketball.), and piano, with playing the (Ana is good at playing the piano.).
prerequisite: A1 7.13 tennis and sing; A1 7.6 paint; A1+ 3.4 isn't/aren't; A1+ 7.6 like + -ing; A1+ 1.3 swim and run.
speaking_outcome: Join good at (GOOD-at) and stress the activity; say isn't good at with a clear t; stress BAS-ket-ball on the first part and pi-A-no on the second. Do not require native-like speed.
